wines.name: Diamond Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Howell Mountain Napa Valley

officialNotes.en: The official bottle image identifies 2024. Trader Joe’s describes ripe dark fruit, cola and cacao in this Howell Mountain Cabernet.
officialNotes.zh: 官网酒瓶图标明 2024 年份。Trader Joe’s 描述这款豪威尔山赤霞珠偏成熟深色水果、可乐和可可。

reputation.en: The appeal is Howell Mountain Cabernet at the Diamond Reserve price. The label registration identifies Precision Brand Collection as the registrant.
reputation.zh: 看点是以 Diamond Reserve 的价位买到豪威尔山赤霞珠。酒标登记记录列出的登记方是 Precision Brand Collection。

note.en: Same Howell Mountain appellation and grape. Dunn is a structured, cellar-oriented reference for mountain Cabernet.
note.zh: 同为豪威尔山赤霞珠。Dunn 单宁结构更强，是偏陈年的山地赤霞珠参考。

rationale.en: Available evidence falls short of a defensible score for this release.
rationale.zh: 现有证据不足以稳妥地为这个发行版本评分。

officialNotes.en: A dry German Riesling with lively acidity, citrus and orchard fruit. The public tasting covers an earlier release of the same label.
officialNotes.zh: 德国干型雷司令，酸度鲜活，偏柑橘与果园水果。公开品鉴对应这个酒标的较早版本。

reputation.en: Reverse Wine Snob found it crisp and pleasing for the money; the store listing does not consistently identify a vintage.
reputation.zh: Reverse Wine Snob 认为它清爽、价格实惠。门店通用条目未固定标明年份。

comparison.name: Dr. Loosen Red Slate Riesling Dry

note.en: A dry German Riesling reference from the Mosel, with a distinct slate-origin profile.
note.zh: 德国摩泽尔干型雷司令的参考，呈现红板岩产区的特色。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

sources.label: Dr. Loosen Red Slate Riesling Dry
Reverse Wine Snob · Emma Reichart Dry Riesling

officialNotes.en: Trader Joe’s describes a soft California red blend with blackberry, plum, mocha and sweet oak notes.
officialNotes.zh: Trader Joe’s 描述这款加州红混酿单宁柔和，有黑莓、李子、摩卡和甜香橡木风味。

reputation.en: Its appeal is plush fruit at a low price. Published Moon X Cabernet and Pinot Noir tests concern different bottles.
reputation.zh: 看点是低价和饱满果香。Moon X 赤霞珠或黑皮诺的横评对应的是其他酒款。

comparison.name: DAOU Pessimist Paso Robles Red Blend

note.en: A richer-priced benchmark for a dark, fruit-forward California red blend. DAOU identifies Paso Robles sourcing and a different blend.
note.zh: 同属果味浓郁、颜色深的加州红混酿。DAOU 标明来自帕索罗布尔斯，混酿配比另有不同。

rationale.en: Available evidence falls short of a defensible score for this release.
rationale.zh: 现有证据不足以稳妥地为这个发行版本评分。

officialNotes.en: A fruit-forward California Cabernet with a rounded style. A supermarket blind tasting offers a bottle-level comparison.
officialNotes.zh: 果香主导的加州赤霞珠，风格圆润；有独立的超市酒盲品可供参考。

reputation.en: Low price is central to its appeal; the blind buying guide covers the label but does not establish the vintage in this listing.
reputation.zh: 它的吸引力主要在价格。盲品对比涵盖该酒标，但无法对应这里的具体年份。

note.en: A step up in price within California Cabernet. JUSTIN specifies Paso Robles, a narrower source than the budget label.
note.zh: 同为加州赤霞珠，JUSTIN 价位更高，且明确标示更窄的帕索罗布尔斯产区。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

officialNotes.en: A Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Grigio blend that favors crisp refreshment over weight.
officialNotes.zh: 长相思与灰皮诺混酿，偏清爽轻盈，适合冰镇。

reputation.en: CheapWineFinder tasted the 2025 release as a casual summer white. The retailer’s listing can span later vintages.
reputation.zh: CheapWineFinder 试饮的是 2025 年份，定位是轻松的夏季白酒。零售条目可能沿用到后续年份。

note.en: A crisp white that highlights the Pinot Grigio side of Sauvigio. It comes from northern Italy and does not contain Sauvignon Blanc.
note.zh: 清爽的白葡萄酒，可对照 Sauvigio 中灰皮诺带来的风格。它来自意大利北部，未混入长相思。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

wines.name: Tazmin Breeze New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc

officialNotes.en: A light New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc with the citrus-driven freshness associated with the style.
officialNotes.zh: 轻盈型新西兰长相思，风格偏明亮柑橘与清新酸度。

reputation.en: Summer buying guides discuss it as a distinctive inexpensive white; tasting coverage is limited and the listing does not identify a vintage.
reputation.zh: 夏季选购指南把它当作一款有特色的低价白酒。品鉴资料较少，条目未注明年份。

note.en: A benchmark for crisp New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc. Cloudy Bay specifically comes from Marlborough.
note.zh: 同为清爽的新西兰长相思。云雾之湾的产区明确为马尔堡。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

sources.label: Tasting Table · Trader Joe’s summer beverages

officialNotes.en: A Rhône-inspired Santa Barbara red blend largely sourced from Santa Ynez Valley. Trader Joe’s describes a full body, soft tannins, cedar and cocoa.
officialNotes.zh: 受罗讷河谷启发的圣巴巴拉红混酿，葡萄主要来自圣伊内斯谷。官方描述酒体饱满、单宁柔顺，带雪松和可可。

reputation.en: The one-liter format suits sharing. The available product-specific feature is from Trader Joe’s, so independent tasting evidence remains thin.
reputation.zh: 一升装适合分享。目前能匹配到的是 Trader Joe’s 自己的介绍，独立品鉴证据仍少。

note.en: A Cabernet-led California blend for comparison with an everyday red. Claret has a more defined Bordeaux-style profile.
note.zh: 以赤霞珠为主的加州混酿，可与日常餐酒对照。Claret 的波尔多混酿风格更明确。

rationale.en: Available evidence falls short of a defensible score for this release.
rationale.zh: 现有证据不足以稳妥地为这个发行版本评分。

sources.label: Inside Trader Joe’s · spring wine tasting

officialNotes.en: A dry French white sparkler. An independent tasting describes fruit and delicate bubbles in the blanc-style bottling.
officialNotes.zh: 法国干型白起泡酒。独立品鉴提到果香和较细的气泡。

reputation.en: The regular Opaline Brut is an affordable aperitif; Opaline Pinot Noir Brut Rosé reviews apply to the pink bottle.
reputation.zh: 普通版 Opaline Brut 定位平价开胃酒；Opaline 黑皮诺干型桃红的评论对应另一瓶。

comparison.name: Louis Bouillot Perle de Vigne Crémant de Bourgogne Brut

note.en: French white sparkling wine at a higher price per 750 mL. Louis Bouillot is an appellation-designated Crémant made by the traditional method.
note.zh: 按 750 毫升折算价格更高的法国白起泡酒。Louis Bouillot 是采用传统法酿造、明确标注产区的勃艮第克雷芒。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
rationale.zh: 评分结合现有品鉴、目录价格和酒款风格。

officialNotes.en: The 2022 Napa Cabernet opens on black cherry, cedar and vanilla, with smooth, juicy dark fruit in the matching tasting.
officialNotes.zh: 2022 年纳帕赤霞珠先有黑樱桃、雪松和香草，同年份品鉴认为入口柔和，深色果味多汁。

reputation.en: Reverse Wine Snob liked the balance at under $10 and identified DNA Vineyards.
reputation.zh: Reverse Wine Snob 肯定其不到 10 美元的平衡表现，并指出生产方为 DNA Vineyards。

note.en: A premium Napa Cabernet benchmark for comparison. Cakebread’s Napa Valley blend is broader than an individual district bottling.
note.zh: 可作高价纳帕谷赤霞珠的参照。Cakebread 的纳帕谷混酿覆盖范围比单一子产区酒款更广。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
rationale.zh: 评分结合现有品鉴、目录价格和酒款风格。

officialNotes.en: A dry Italian Pinot Grigio with a light, crisp profile, as described in a tasting of the 2024 Otto bottling.
officialNotes.zh: 干型意大利灰皮诺。2024 年 Otto 品鉴描述它清爽、轻盈。

reputation.en: CheapWineFinder presents it as an easy-sipping $8 white. The catalog does not fix the vintage.
reputation.zh: CheapWineFinder 把它视为约 8 美元的易饮白酒；目录未固定年份。

note.en: A more expensive dry Pinot Grigio benchmark from northern Italy. It shares the grape, with a different regional sourcing.
note.zh: 来自意大利北部的高价干型灰皮诺，同葡萄品种，产区来源另有区别。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

wines.name: Reserve Meritage Paso Robles 2023 Red Wine

officialNotes.en: The 2023 Paso Robles Reserve Meritage is a Bordeaux-style red blend. A matching vintage review describes a generous, structured palate.
officialNotes.zh: 2023 年帕索罗布尔斯 Reserve Meritage 是波尔多风格红混酿。同年份品鉴认为其口感饱满、有结构。

reputation.en: Sipped Reviews tasted 2023 Lot 276. The official description lists six Bordeaux grapes; the Grand Reserve Lot 129 is a separate release.
reputation.zh: Sipped Reviews 品鉴了 2023 年 Lot 276。官方介绍列出六种波尔多葡萄；Grand Reserve Lot 129 是另一个发行。

note.en: A higher-priced Paso Robles Bordeaux-style blend. The blend proportions and oak program are specific to Isosceles.
note.zh: 更高价的帕索罗布尔斯波尔多风格混酿。葡萄配比和用桶方式各有不同。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
rationale.zh: 评分结合现有品鉴、目录价格和酒款风格。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Blanc de Blancs Napa Valley Sparkling Wine

officialNotes.en: Napa Valley blanc de blancs with a fine mousse and a citrus-and-orchard-fruit profile. The 2026 Flyer features this as a holiday sparkler.
officialNotes.zh: 纳帕谷白中白起泡酒，气泡细致，偏柑橘和果园水果风格。2026 年官方宣传册把它列为节日酒款。

reputation.en: Blonde Voyage Nashville tasted Lot 127. The named lot and Napa origin make the review a useful reference for this bottling.
reputation.zh: Blonde Voyage Nashville 品鉴了 Lot 127，可作为纳帕谷这款酒的具名批次参考。

note.en: A richer California brut sparkling benchmark. Domaine Carneros is a vintage Carneros blend.
note.zh: 风格更丰富的加州干型起泡酒。Domaine Carneros 是标注年份的卡内罗斯混酿。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
rationale.zh: 评分结合现有品鉴、目录价格和酒款风格。

wines.name: Platinum Reserve Brut Rosé Napa Valley Sparkling Wine

officialNotes.en: A dry pink Napa Valley sparkler from the holiday Platinum Reserve release. Trader Joe’s describes a fresh, red-fruit-led profile.
officialNotes.zh: 节日 Platinum Reserve 系列的纳帕谷干型桃红起泡酒。Trader Joe’s 把它描述为偏清新红果风格。

reputation.en: The official holiday guide features this release. The widely published blind tasting applies to the Sonoma County rosé, a different bottling.
reputation.zh: 官方节日指南收录了这一款。较常见的盲品报道对应另一款索诺玛县桃红起泡酒。

comparison.name: Domaine Carneros Cuvée de la Pompadour Brut Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced California brut rosé. This Carneros bottling has its own Pinot Noir-led blend and house style.
note.zh: 价位更高的加州干型桃红起泡酒。这款卡内罗斯的配方以黑皮诺为主，酒庄风格鲜明。

rationale.en: Available evidence falls short of a defensible score for this release.
rationale.zh: 现有证据不足以稳妥地为这个发行版本评分。

officialNotes.en: The matching 2023 Sonoma Chardonnay tasting describes citrus, apple and melon over a soft, creamy texture.
officialNotes.zh: 对应 2023 年份的索诺玛霞多丽品鉴提到柑橘、苹果和蜜瓜，口感柔滑带奶油感。

reputation.en: The first-hand review thought the fruit and length delivered good value. The 2024 vintage is reviewed separately.
reputation.zh: 独立品鉴认为其果味和余味在这个价格有优势。2024 年版另有不同品鉴。

note.en: A premium Sonoma Chardonnay comparison from Russian River Ranches, with a citrus-and-barrel-spice profile.
note.zh: 更高价的索诺玛霞多丽参考，来自俄罗斯河谷酒款系列，呈现柑橘与桶陈香料风味。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
rationale.zh: 评分结合现有品鉴、目录价格和酒款风格。

wines.name: Compass Bridge Sonoma County Pinot Noir

officialNotes.en: The Sonoma County Pinot Noir is a red-fruited, fresh style, with the retailer identifying the 2023 release.
officialNotes.zh: 索诺玛县黑皮诺，偏清新红果风格，官方产品页标有 2023 年份。

reputation.en: A sommelier buying guide highlighted the label as an inexpensive food wine. The tasting vintage was not specified in that guide.
reputation.zh: 侍酒师选购指南推荐这款酒用于平价配餐，但指南未注明品鉴年份。

comparison.name: La Crema Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir

note.en: A pricier Sonoma Pinot Noir with a narrower coastal appellation.
note.zh: 同为索诺玛黑皮诺，La Crema 来自范围更窄的索诺玛海岸产区，价位更高。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

officialNotes.en: A French white blend with the roundness of Chardonnay and the aromatics of Viognier. The official listing identifies the 2024 release.
officialNotes.zh: 法国白混酿，霞多丽提供圆润口感，维欧尼带来香气。官方条目标明 2024 年。

reputation.en: The bottle appears in sommelier and shopper recommendations for affordable pairing. The independent tasting notes do not consistently give a vintage.
reputation.zh: 侍酒师和消费者推荐它作为平价配餐酒，但独立品鉴未一致标明年份。

note.en: Another southern French white built around Chardonnay. Grand Ardèche uses oak and omits the Viognier in the Maison Barboulot blend.
note.zh: 同为以霞多丽为核心的法国南部白酒。Grand Ardèche 带橡木桶风格，不含 Maison Barboulot 混酿中的维欧尼。

officialNotes.en: The 2023 Pinot Noir from The Dalles is an Oregon Columbia Valley bottling, with berry fruit and an earthy edge in the published tasting.
officialNotes.zh: 这款 2023 年黑皮诺来自俄勒冈州 The Dalles 的哥伦比亚谷。公开品鉴提到浆果和少许泥土气息。

reputation.en: The exact vintage drew favorable independent attention, and the winery owner documented the relationship with Trader Joe’s.
reputation.zh: 对应年份获得了正面的独立关注。酒庄负责人也证实了与 Trader Joe’s 的合作。

note.en: A separate Pinot Noir sold by Sunshine Mill, the Oregon family operation behind the TJ vineyard bottling. The winery lists this older release separately.
note.zh: Trader Joe’s 这款酒背后的俄勒冈家族酒庄 Sunshine Mill 另有一款高价黑皮诺，酒庄单独列出了这个较早的年份。

originNotes.en: Winery owner James Martin identified the family’s The Dalles vineyard as the source of the 2023 Pinot Noir for Trader Joe’s.
originNotes.zh: 酒庄负责人 James Martin 确认，Trader Joe’s 这款 2023 年黑皮诺的葡萄来自家族位于俄勒冈州 The Dalles 的葡萄园。

officialNotes.en: A lightly sparkling Valencian fruit wine made with oranges, with bright citrus sweetness.
officialNotes.zh: 瓦伦西亚橙子果酒，微起泡，带明亮的甜橙风味。

reputation.en: Sporked singled it out as a seasonal curiosity worth trying. It suits shoppers looking for a fruit drink with wine-like bubbles.
reputation.zh: Sporked 将其列为值得尝试的季节性特色饮品。比较适合喜欢带气泡果酒的人。

note.en: A specialty Spanish wine that also features real orange flavor. This Málaga Moscatel is sweet and still, so the comparison is about citrus character rather than bubbles.
note.zh: 同样突出真实橙香的西班牙特色酒。这款马拉加莫斯卡托是静态甜酒，适合对照柑橘风味和甜度。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
rationale.zh: 评分结合现有品鉴、目录价格和酒款风格。

officialNotes.en: A light southern French Cinsault rosé; the tasted release shows a dry, bright fruit profile.
officialNotes.zh: 法国南部轻盈型神索桃红，品鉴对应的版本偏干型、果味明亮。

reputation.en: Vinopointer liked the 2023 release for warm-weather drinking and its low price. The listing does not guarantee that vintage.
reputation.zh: Vinopointer 喜欢 2023 年份作为暖天饮用的低价桃红；通用条目不保证年份。

comparison.name: Gérard Bertrand Côte des Roses Rosé

note.en: A higher-priced dry pink wine from southern France. Its blend gives a useful contrast with the lighter everyday TJ rosé.
note.zh: 来自法国南部的高价干型桃红。它的混酿可与较轻盈的 Trader Joe’s 日常桃红对照。

rationale.en: The score is provisional because bottle-level tasting or release metadata is limited.
rationale.zh: 单瓶品鉴或发行资料有限，分数仅供初步参考。

officialNotes.en: Dry German Pinot Noir rosé with red-fruit freshness. The official Flyer presents it as a bright seasonal pairing.
officialNotes.zh: 德国干型黑皮诺桃红，偏清新红果风格。官方宣传册将其推荐作季节性配餐酒。

reputation.en: Independent tasting and the IWSC entry support the label’s value, with IWSC identifying the 2023 vintage specifically.
reputation.zh: 有独立试饮和 IWSC 条目可供参考，其中 IWSC 对应 2023 年份。

officialNotes.en: A Tuscan red made in the Governo style, with ripe fruit and a rounder texture than a lean Sangiovese bottling.
officialNotes.zh: 托斯卡纳 Governo 风格红酒，果味较成熟，口感比清瘦型桑娇维塞更圆润。

reputation.en: The $9 bottle has positive coverage as an approachable pasta red. The tasting source identifies Terre del Casone and the Governo designation.
reputation.zh: 约 9 美元，作为易饮的意面配餐红酒获正面评价。品鉴明确写出 Terre del Casone 与 Governo 标识。

comparison.name: Poggio al Casone La Cattura Toscana

note.en: A higher-tier red from the same Tuscan estate. La Cattura is led by Teroldego, while the Governo bottling takes a different stylistic approach.
note.zh: 同一家托斯卡纳酒庄的高价红酒。La Cattura 以特罗德哥为主，与这款采用 Governo 风格的酒配方不同。

originNotes.en: Poggio al Casone is the estate behind the Casone Toscana line. The wines listed here are separately named bottlings.
originNotes.zh: Casone Toscana 系列来自 Poggio al Casone 酒庄。这里的两款酒分别有独立的酒名。

officialNotes.en: The 2023 Tuscan Vermentino shows citrus, peach and a lightly herbal, saline edge.
officialNotes.zh: 2023 年托斯卡纳维蒙蒂诺带柑橘、桃子，以及轻微草本与咸鲜感。

reputation.en: Reverse Wine Snob tasted the named 2023 release and liked its dry finish as a seafood pairing.
reputation.zh: Reverse Wine Snob 品鉴了明确标注的 2023 年版，肯定其干爽收尾，适合搭配海鲜。

note.en: Same Tuscan grape in a higher-tier Bolgheri bottling. Antinori gives a coastal, appellation-specific reference.
note.zh: 同为托斯卡纳维蒙蒂诺，Antinori 来自沿海的保格利，产区标示更具体、价位更高。

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.

rationale.en: The score combines the available tasting evidence with the listed price and the wine’s style.
